summary: 8/8 required checks pass on a fresh run in this session. Independent adversarial testing (13 scenarios in throwaway clones) found the git-layer enforcement real for ordinary violations (7/7 caught: verifier writing scripts/, verifier writing state/claims.jsonl, missing trailers, unknown session, unheld role, edited state line, deleted state file); R3/R4/R5 hold at the state layer (self-review, append-only, git-blame authorship binding all rejected). Four gaps remain that the standard suite cannot detect: F1 (High) Session-Id is self-declared and the branch binding is checked for HEAD only, so a commit forging another session's identity passes check-all (demonstrated: the guard itself weakened under a forged bootstrap identity, check-all ok=true); F2 (High) merge commits are skipped and --first-parent excludes side-branch commits, so scripts/ and .github/ can be landed with no trailers and no proposal (demonstrated, check-all ok=true); F3 (Medium) "check-commits --stage land" is not a CLI argument, so CI's land gate exits 2 with a usage error - called programmatically it is vacuous for merge commits and misattributes every file to the verifier for squash merges; F4 (Medium) "researchos_session.py close" on your own session makes check-commits fail with "session is closed". Also: RQ-001 lists a required check "governance_review" that the suite never emits (it emits "policy"), and required_checks are never compared against a review's checks; the verifier may rewrite gitswarm/artifacts/readout_snapshot.json, so readout_snapshot proves only "no drift since the last verifier re-baseline". Verdict: pass with conditions. "pass" means the 8 required checks passed, not that the harness is gap-free. F1-F4 must be closed by a follow-up proposal (PRP-002) before this harness is treated as a hard gate; until then the merge to main remains the human gate of record.

checks.detail: PRP-002 §2 acceptance FAILED. (1) Rewriting REV-001's summary in place leaves `researchos_guard.py check-append-only` exit 0 and `_check_hash_chain_for_file('state/reviews.jsonl')` = []. (2) Deleting the REV-001 line entirely leaves `check-all --json` ok=true (exit 0). (3) A new REV-9001 line appended and committed legitimately, then rewritten in place, leaves `check-all --json` ok=true. Cause: the baseline prefix for state/reviews.jsonl is the empty file at e236b57; the per-ID revision chain only verifies supersedes of later revisions and does not anchor the latest line or a file-level head. The new test test_append_only_hash_chain_is_enforced only asserts the clean file passes (no tampering), so it passes on a tampered tree. See verifications/prp002_verifier_f99f5b7f.md.

summary: Independent verifier SES-f99f5b7f (branch arena/f99f5b7f-researchos; not the proposer). The 13 automated RQ-002 checks all pass (policy, schema_and_integrity, regression_tests, benchmark_reproducible, readout_snapshot, append_only, role_guard, role_separation, bootstrap_land_requires_approval, merge_commits_are_audited, approval_consistency, distinct_reviews, governance_review). However the proposal's own C2/A1 acceptance (§2) and the §14 DoD invariant 'append-only authenticity' FAIL under independent adversarial tests: rewriting REV-001 in place, deleting REV-001, or rewriting a newly appended/committed review line all leave check-append-only/check-all green. The claimed rolling hash chain does not protect the latest line and the prefix baseline for reviews.jsonl is an empty file. The new hash-chain test is vacuous (it never tampers). Also literal §14 commands fail: `check-commits --json` exits 2 (argparse has no --json), verifications/prp002_design_probes.py does not exist, and the suite has 57 tests not 52. Independent positive tests pass for F1 (forged non-HEAD identity rejected), F2 (real --no-ff merge with trailerless side commit or trailerless merge rejected), F4 (close commit accepted, post-close rejected), G1/G3/G4. Verdict: fail; do not approve/land until A1/C2 is actually implemented and a real tamper test is added. Review id REV-003 is used deliberately because REV-002 already exists on the parallel verifier line arena/363c9e54-researchos.
